text:
Grade 3 saw second highest reading MCA participation at Gordon Bailey Elementary for 2024-25
L. G. Lee
According to the Minnesota Department of Education, third-grade students at Gordon Bailey Elementary remained the group with the second highest participation rate on the reading section of the 2024-25 MCA.
Among 375 students who completed the reading test at Gordon Bailey Elementary, 118 were third-graders.
About 60% of third-grade participants achieved reading proficiency based on test criteria.
The MCA and Alternate Minnesota Comprehensive Assessment (Alt MCA) are statewide exams that gauge how students are progressing toward Minnesota’s academic standards and are required for both state and federal accountability purposes. The tests measure skills in math, reading, and science depending on grade. Most students take the MCA, while some students receiving special education, if eligible, may take the Alt MCA.
Trends on Minnesota's MCA exams show a decline in overall proficiency since pre-pandemic years, with State Report Card data showing math proficiency rates more than 7% lower and reading proficiency rates nearly 5% lower than 2019.
| Grade | # of Students Tested | Proficiency in reading |
|---|---|---|
| 3rd | 118 | 60% |
| 4th | 118 | 42% |
| 5th | 139 | 56% |
Details for this article come from the Minnesota Department of Education. Source data are available here.
